rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an inch, including a literal measurement, rainfall depth, and a very short distance such as in 唔郁一吋.

example.english: This rope is one inch long.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 jau5 jat1 cyun3 coeng4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for advancing very slowly, including inching along in a direction.

example.english: The traffic is jammed, so the car can only inch along.
example.jyutping: sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 gaa3 ce1 maan6 maan6 juk1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on moving forward by only a small amount rather than on moving slowly.

example.english: Move the car forward an inch and it will be in position.
example.traditional: 架車向前郁少少就到位喇。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 hoeng3 cin4 juk1 siu2 siu2 zau6 dou3 wai6 laa3
